product.name: Quantix SpectraScan 300
product.description: The Quantix SpectraScan 300 is a compact, high‑precision spectrophotometer designed for routine UV‑Vis analysis in research laboratories. It features a 1‑inch optical path cell holder, a 10‑µm resolution detector, and an integrated USB‑C interface for rapid data transfer to laptops or networked systems. The instrument operates on a 120‑V AC supply with a 150‑W power consumption, and it can be powered via a 12‑V DC adapter for portable use. Its ergonomic chassis measures 45 cm in width, 30 cm in depth, and 25 cm in height, weighing 12 kg, and it comes finished in a matte black finish. The SpectraScan 300 delivers linearity better than 0.5 % across 200‑800 nm and supports batch analysis through its software suite. It is ideal for educational labs, small‑scale research, and quality‑control applications.
